capability: Isolated strict Windows runtime candidate verification
searchEvidence: Existing RuntimeCandidateImageInspector is non-executing PE fact authority; no native signature/import/export verifier exists in this subsystem.

ExternalProcessorEnvironmentLoader and ExternalCombinerToolResolver already own bounded manifest discovery and pinned executable identity; reuse these snapshots rather than read manifests independently.

SystemExternalProcessRunner provides hidden argument-list launch, bounded output, cancellation and timeout; this slice must verify real trusted-child exit/kill and cannot claim stronger untested cleanup guarantees.
Microsoft WINTRUST_DATA documentation confirms entire-chain excluding-root revocation flags; network retrieval is allowed without cache-only, but valid Windows revocation caches may be used.
semanticOwner: Infrastructure runtime evidence adapter and existing external-tool discovery; Application remains selection/readiness owner
terminalContract: Only a correlated successful trusted-host probe plus compatible pinned-tool import/export evidence yields complete Verified; unknown, revocation unavailable, malformed, timeout and identity mismatch reject without executing the candidate

designReview.evidence: Independent R3 architecture admission approved isolated same-host internal probe, 30-second bound and actual exit evidence, working directory outside candidate/user-DLL directories, strict correlated versioned JSON, pinned snapshot hash and actual WinTrust signer state. Require WinVerifyTrust success with whole-chain/excluding-root revocation and no ignore/cache-only flags, ASN.1 Microsoft Organization, StateClose, and accurate cache semantics. Import names/ordinals come only from verified Combiner snapshots; reject missing/zero/out-of-bounds required exports or required forwarders with finite byte/string/table bounds. Loader change only reuses discovery metadata in this slice. Config-generation/deployment wiring and full Toolchain completion remain separate; firmware and release external gates are retained.
